description: This PHP class implements a legacy materials provider for AWS S3 encryption, utilizing AWS KMS for key management. It supports encrypting and decrypting data keys through KMS's API, with mechanisms to handle encryption envelopes and material descriptions.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProvider
classes.description: A legacy implementation of a materials provider that uses AWS KMS to encrypt and decrypt data encryption keys for client-side encryption workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a KmsMaterialsProvider with a specified KmsClient and optional KMS key ID.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a new instance based on the provided metadata envelope, extracting KMS key information.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Returns the materials description, specifically the KMS customer master key ID.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the constant string identifying the wrapping algorithm used, which is 'kms'.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Encrypts a content encryption key (CEK) using AWS KMS's Encrypt API, returning a base64-encoded ciphertext.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted CEK using AWS KMS's Decrypt API and returns the plaintext key.
